title: feat(tooling): gate a DECLARED-but-never-imported dependency, and remove the 37 this repository had
body:
Fixes #8198

`check:phantom-deps` judges imports that are not declared, and its own scope note names the direction it leaves open. Nothing judged the reverse, so a declaration could outlive its last consumer indefinitely — which is what happened to `recharts` in `@object-ui/components` after objectui#7397 deleted its only importer, and what objectui#7625 removed by hand.

Notation note: this body spells placeholders as WORDS, never in their real angle-bracket form, because this repository has measured that GitHub's body sanitizer deletes tag-shaped fragments even inside backticks.

## What landed

- `scripts/check-unused-dependencies.mjs` — `pnpm check:unused-deps`, judging `dependencies` and `optionalDependencies` of every released package.
- `scripts/__tests__/check-unused-dependencies.test.ts` — 37 cases.
- One line in the root `package.json` scripts block, beside `check:phantom-deps`. Merged (not rebased) onto `origin/main` after PR #8277 landed `check:comment-mask-corpus` into the same block; both lines are present.
- 37 unused runtime declarations removed across 16 manifests, plus one `@types/…` orphaned by them.
- One documentation snippet repaired — see "The one thing that went red" below.
- A `minor` changeset, because the removals can break a consumer relying on hoisting.

## Home decision: a new file, not a second direction inside `check-phantom-dependencies.mjs`

Judged on the four axes; the deciding one was the first.

- **实际业务需求 (measured, not asserted).** The two directions need OPPOSITE file populations, and that is the reason phantom-deps itself gave for leaving this direction alone. phantom-deps reads `src/` only and must — a `vite.config.ts` import is not a shipped import. This gate must read the whole package — a dependency consumed only by a build config, only by a stylesheet, or only by a `bin/` helper IS consumed. Measured: the wider scan is what clears 12 of the 41 hits. One scanner cannot serve both scopes without a per-question switch, which is two gates wearing one exit code. The exit codes matter separately: phantom-deps is green with zero findings, this direction had 41 on `fc32921aa`, so fusing them would have meant holding phantom-deps' verdict hostage to a cleanup or landing this one non-enforcing.
- **项目长远合理性.** Contract-first: one gate, one question, one verdict. Every parser helper is IMPORTED from phantom-deps (`discoverPackages`, `readReleaseGroup`, `moduleSpecifiers`, `packageNameOf`, `isBuiltin`, `SKIP_DIRS`, `SOURCE_FILE`), pinned by a test, so the two directions cannot come to disagree about what an import is. No machinery is duplicated.
- **防 AI 写代码犯错.** A red names one question. The failure text names the package, the field, the key and the three scans that found no consumer, and the hint says what to do. Folding a second direction into an 800-line file makes both harder to act on.
- **创业阶段不扩散.** A new file plus one script line is the smaller surface, not the larger: fusing would be the same code in a bigger file, plus a switch.

## The census, on `fc32921aa`

40 released packages, 361 `dependencies` keys, 89 peers, 345 devDependencies.

| field | declared | with no consumer |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `dependencies` | 361 | 41 |
| `optionalDependencies` | 0 | 0 |
| `peerDependencies` | 89 | 22 |
| `devDependencies` | 345 | 67 |

Class table, after the three detection rules — every hit classified before anything was decided, no class ignored without a reason:

| class | count | disposition |
|:--|--:|:--|
| stylesheet-only (`@plugin 'tailwindcss-animate'`, `@import 'tailwindcss'`) | 4 | DETECTION RULE — CSS at-rules read from `.css` / `.scss` / `.sass` / `.less` |
| type-only (`@types/glob`, whose `glob` is imported) | 1 | DETECTION RULE — `@types/X` follows X, with npm's `@types/scope__name` mangling inverted |
| global-scope types (`@types/node`) | 0 in a gated field | NAMED CARVE-OUT, counted every run — its consumer is `process` / `Buffer` / the `NodeJS` namespace, which no import scan can see; a scan that demanded a builtin import would red a package for reading an environment variable |
| consumed only outside `src/` (a build config, a `bin/` helper) | 12 | DETECTION RULE — the whole package directory is scanned |
| emitted into GENERATED source as a string (`@object-ui/cli`) | 2 | ALLOWANCE with `verify` — `objectui dev` runs the generated app against the CLI's own install |
| inlined by a bundler named in its config (`object-ui`, `tsup` `noExternal`) | 2 | ALLOWANCE with `verify` |
| genuinely dead — the name appears nowhere in the package but its own manifest and CHANGELOG | 37 | REMOVED |
| plugin-map's `zod` / `@objectstack/spec` (prose in comments only) | (within the 37) | REMOVED |
| string key in a `postcss.config` / `tailwind.config` plugin map | 0 | NO RULE, deliberately — a real class in the wild with zero instances here; written into the header so the next reader knows it was considered, not missed |

The 37 removals, verified by a whole-package grep each before removal:

| package | removed from `dependencies` |
|:--|:--|
| `plugin-designer` | `@dnd-kit/core`, `@dnd-kit/sortable`, `@dnd-kit/utilities`, `@object-ui/fields` |
| `plugin-chatbot` | `react-markdown`, `react-syntax-highlighter`, `remark-gfm` (+ the orphaned `@types/react-syntax-highlighter` from `devDependencies`) |
| `plugin-report` | `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `clsx`, `react-i18next`, `tailwind-merge` |
| `plugin-map` | `@objectstack/spec`, `lucide-react`, `zod` |
| `runner` | `class-variance-authority`, `clsx`, `tailwind-merge` |
| `layout` | `clsx`, `tailwind-merge`, `react-dom` |
| `plugin-dashboard` | `clsx`, `tailwind-merge`, `react-dom` |
| `plugin-ai` | `@object-ui/react`, `clsx`, `tailwind-merge` |
| `core` | `lodash`, `zod` |
| `fields` | `clsx`, `tailwind-merge` |
| `console` | `@object-ui/react-runtime`, `sucrase` |
| `auth` | `@object-ui/types` |
| `plugin-calendar` | `@object-ui/fields` |
| `plugin-editor`, `plugin-markdown` | `@object-ui/react` |
| `react` | `react-hook-form` |

`pnpm install` afterwards: `Packages: -10`.

`layout` and `plugin-dashboard`'s `react-dom` is the interesting one — an exact pin in `dependencies` alongside a peer range, i.e. a library hard-depending on the renderer it asks its host to supply. Their siblings `plugin-charts` / `plugin-form` / `plugin-list` do not do this. The `react` half of the same shape is invisible to this gate (`react` IS imported) and is filed as objectui#8303.

## What is gated, and what is only MEASURED

`peerDependencies` is NOT gated. A peer is a constraint on the HOST's graph, not a claim to import the name; 21 of the 22 unconsumed peers are `react-dom`, the renderer these component libraries require of whatever mounts them. Gating it would red 21 packages on day one over a convention — a decision for the maintainer, filed as objectui#8300, not a rider here.

`devDependencies` is NOT gated. They are the field a consumer's install does not fetch, which is the premise phantom-deps' own runtime tier rests on; the 67 remaining are dominated by toolchain named BY STRING in a config rather than imported.

Both counts are printed on every run, so the size of both concessions stays visible instead of being absorbed.

## The Atoms constraint (AGENTS.md line 61): measured, and NOT given its own assertion

`@object-ui/components` declares 48 runtime dependencies today — 6 workspace siblings, `@objectstack/spec`, 28 Radix primitives, and 13 Shadcn upstream libraries (`cmdk`, `date-fns`, `embla-carousel-react`, `input-otp`, `lucide-react`, `next-themes`, `react-day-picker`, `react-hook-form`, `react-resizable-panels`, `sonner`, `vaul`, plus the `cn()` trio and `tailwindcss-animate`). Every one has a consumer; the package is green under the generic scan.

An explicit allowed-list assertion was weighed on the four axes and **not** added, and the deciding evidence is the card's own instance:

- **实际业务需求.** A named allowlist would NOT have caught `recharts`. `recharts` was legitimately on the list the day it was added — `chart.tsx` imported it — and the defect was that the importer went away. What catches that is exactly the generic unused-declaration scan, which is what landed. An allowlist is strictly weaker for the measured instance.
- **项目长远合理性.** "Zero heavy 3rd-party deps" has no measurable definition in this tree — no byte budget, no list, no gate reads a size. A 48-name allowlist would be a ledger with no rule behind it, and every legitimate new Shadcn primitive would be a ledger edit.
- **防 AI 写代码犯错.** Declaring a list an agent edits to make a red go away is a weaker contract than a rule it cannot argue with.
- **创业阶段不扩散.** No pull: the tree satisfies the constraint today, and defining "heavy" is a maintainer's decision, not a rider on a tooling card.

Reported, not implemented. If the maintainer wants "heavy" made mechanical, that needs the definition first.

## Controls

The card's own control, reproduced on this tree with the gate's scanner:

```
lucide-react         packages/components   CONSUMED (import)       — 70 files, matching the card's 0c8dbc492 reading
tailwindcss-animate  packages/components   CONSUMED (css at-rule)  — packages/components/src/index.css
recharts             packages/components   NOT CONSUMED            — 0 files; and no longer declared (objectui#7625)
```

So the zero is a real zero, and `recharts` is the true negative this gate would have caught.

## Ablation, on the committed tree, trap-restored and blob-hash proved

Each leg proved its mutation reached disk by an on-disk marker count before and after, and each restore was proved by `git diff HEAD` being empty — never by a `git checkout` exit code.

```
baseline  check-unused-dependencies.mjs  blob=fe12daa98a7a9428dbafedb727213c364392bb59
baseline  packages/core/package.json     blob=fb341c8ce4d61a08d3d6eead8d433d1948ec9924

LEG 0  unmodified                                                  EXIT=0  green
LEG 1  plant an unused dependencies key in packages/core           EXIT=1  marker 0 to 1; output names 'ghost-dependency-8198'
LEG 2  delete the live allowance row for cli -> components         EXIT=1  marker 1 to 0; reports @object-ui/cli declares '@object-ui/components'
LEG 3  add an allowance for a key that IS consumed (self-deleting) EXIT=1  marker 0 to 2; reports stale-allowance, "now HAS a consumer ... TabBar.tsx"
LEG 4  unmodified again, same run                                  EXIT=0  green
```

Leg 3 is the one that matters most: an allowance that has stopped being NEEDED reds, not just one that has stopped holding. That is what keeps this from becoming a permanent allowlist.

## The one thing that went red, and why the fix went where it did

`scripts/__tests__/check-doc-snippet-types.test.ts` failed after the removals:

```
content/docs/guide/objectos-integration.mdx:96 react-dom/client
```

That snippet's `react-dom/client` import resolved only because `@object-ui/layout` carried the `react-dom` entry this PR removed — the doc gate's `paths` map is built from `dependencies` only, and its own header says so.

The remedy was NOT to put the entry back. That gate's header rules on this exact shape, quoted verbatim:

> ⛔ What this rule exists INSTEAD of, again: adding `@playwright/test` to some package's `dependencies` so the map covers it. See the 2026-08-24 ruling quoted at the end of the next section — a manifest is a claim about what a package needs, and a doc gate's convenience is not that claim.

So the doc was wrong, and had been wrong on an accident: no `@object-ui/*` package installs a DOM renderer for its consumer — every one asks for it as a peer — so a reader copying that block never had the import backed by anything they install. The block now exports `App` and stops at the component boundary; the mounting step is prose naming `createRoot` and `StrictMode` without importing a package the guide cannot promise the reader has. Adjacent context: objectui#8059 is about that same bound's remedy text for peer-declared specifiers.

| gate | exit | verdict line |

| `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/` | 0 | 89 files, 1069 tests passed |

| `pnpm check:dist-completeness` | 0 | 12 packages complete, 1621 emitted files verified |
| `pnpm check:self-import` / `check:side-effects-array` | 0 | green |

| `pnpm lint:root` | 0 | 0 errors, 32 warnings (all pre-existing `no-explicit-any`) |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | 0 | 6599 tracked text files scanned |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | 0 | 1 changeset added |
| `check-changeset-no-major` / `-fixed` / `-overwrite` | 0 | green |
| `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` (all 25 paths) | 0 | NOT GOVERNED |

One gate is NOT green, and it is not this PR's: `node scripts/check-node-esm-load.mjs` exits 1 on its provenance leg because turbo's shared cache replayed 5 packages built by a SIBLING WORKTREE in this container (`objectui-issue-5174-b36`): `mobile`, `permissions`, `providers`, `react-runtime`, `types`. None of those five has a dependency removed by this PR. Its load leg graded 29 entries and reported no failure outside its by-design list. CI builds fresh, so it has no shared-cache question.

## Deviation, declared

`check:unused-deps` has no step in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` beside its sibling `check:phantom-deps`, because that path was outside this session's declared file surface. It IS enforcing today through its pin test's repository-green case, which `pnpm test` runs. The missing step is filed as objectui#8301 with the exact YAML.

## Findings filed out of scope

- objectui#8300 — 21 packages declare a `react-dom` peer no file in them consumes; the convention needs a decision, not a gate.
- objectui#8301 — this gate has no `ci.yml` step.
- objectui#8302 — six plugin `vite.config.ts` files carry alias and globals rows for packages the plugin never imports.
- objectui#8303 — `layout` and `plugin-dashboard` pin `react` in `dependencies` while also asking for it as a peer.

All four are unassigned, labelled `finding` only, deduplicated against the 455 open issues with `check:phantom-deps` as a control term that hit.
